tour.banner.title: 👋 Welcome to Protectado!
tour.banner.text: To get started, create your first child's profile: their schedule and filtering will then become active.
tour.step1.title: Welcome to Protectado
tour.step1.body: Protectado watches over your children's Internet connection: content filtering, cut-off times and monitoring. This short tour explains each tab — one minute, then you create your child's profile.
tour.step2.title: “Dashboard” tab
tour.step2.body: The overview: each child's status, a summary of their activity, and an assistant you can ask questions (“what did my child do today?”).
tour.step3.title: “Profiles” tab
tour.step3.body: The heart of Protectado: one profile per child. Here you set their devices, allowed time slots and filtering level. This is where it all starts.
tour.step4.title: “Manage” tab
tour.step4.body: Everyday settings: grant temporary access (“30 more minutes”), suspend a schedule for an exception, or adjust the allowed/blocked sites.
tour.step5.title: “Devices” tab
tour.step5.body: The list of devices connected to the children's Wi-Fi. You attach each phone or tablet to the right profile so the rules apply.
tour.step6.title: Let's go!
tour.step6.body: You're all set. Let's create your first child's profile together: you'll choose their name, schedule and filtering.
admin_info.title: Protectado access
admin_info.from_home: From your usual Wi-Fi (not the children's), open this address:
admin_info.bookmark: Tip: bookmark this address so you can find it again easily.
admin_info.no_ip: Address unavailable right now — try again in a moment.
admin_info.note: This page only shows the address. The dashboard is not accessible from the children's Wi-Fi.
ob.title: 🛡️ Protectado setup
ob.subtitle: A few steps to connect the box and protect the children's Wi-Fi.
ob.subtitle_dns: One step: choose the dashboard password.
ob.box_hint: Pick your Wi-Fi network and enter ITS key (your box's).
ob.kids_warn: ⚠️ Changing this key later will disconnect the children's devices.
ob.admin_hint: To access the Protectado dashboard later.
ob.recon_hint: The box has joined your network. Its address:
ob.recon_step1: Reconnect this phone to your Wi-Fi "{ssid}".
ob.recon_bookmark: ⭐ Tip: bookmark this address so you can find it again easily.
ob.recon_admin_fallback: If you lose it later (or it changes), connect a device to the children's Wi-Fi and open http://protectado.admin: the address is shown there.
ob.dns_label: ⚠️ Required step: tell your router to use Protectado
ob.dns_intro: Without this step, Protectado sees and filters… nothing at all. Note the box address:
ob.dns_step1: Open your Internet router's interface (often http://192.168.1.1).
ob.dns_step2: Look for “DNS” in the network or DHCP settings.
ob.dns_step3: Replace the DNS server with the address above, and save.
ob.dns_step4: Restart Wi-Fi on your children's devices so they pick it up.
ob.dns_help: If your router does not allow changing the DNS, you can set it device by device, in their Wi-Fi settings.
ob.finish_hint: The box is reachable through your router. Finalize the setup: the children's Wi-Fi will be turned on and filtered, and the setup network will disappear.
ob.finish_hint_dns: The box will apply filtering on your network. The dashboard will then open on its own.
ob.no_networks: No network found — try again or enter the name manually.
ob.err_box_fail: Failed: wrong key or network out of range.
ob.err_kids_len: The children's key must be 8 to 63 characters.
ob.finish_msg_dns: Applying the configuration… This page will open on its own to the dashboard (~30s).
ob.finish_msg_gw: The box is restarting and turning on the children's Wi-Fi… Please wait, this page will reload on its own to the dashboard (~1–2 minutes).

profiles.no_device_title: ⚠️ Filtering is waiting for a device
profiles.no_device_desc: No device is linked to {name} yet, so this schedule isn't applied to anything. Two steps to activate it:
profiles.no_device_step1_gateway: Connect your child's device to the “{ssid}” Wi-Fi network.
profiles.no_device_step1_dns: Check that your child's device is connected to your home Wi-Fi.
profiles.no_device_step2: Open the “Devices” tab and link the device to this profile.
devices.new_desc: Attach each device to a child profile, or ignore it.
devices.grace_note: Devices on the box's Wi-Fi run with no rules at all until they are linked to a profile. Those past {h} h are flagged here.
event.adult_mode_ended: Adult mode ended — back to child profile
event.adult_mode_cancelled: Adult mode cancelled — back to child profile
event.temp_override_ended: Temporary override ended — back to {mode} mode
event.temp_override_cancelled: Temporary override cancelled — back to {mode} mode
event.domain_reblocked: Temporary allowance expired — domain blocked again
event.dns_bypass_suspected: Likely DNS bypass: this device has been on the network for over {h} h without ever using Protectado to resolve site names — filtering does not apply to it
event.device_free_access: Warning: {label} has had unrestricted access on the children's network for over {h} h — no rule applies until it is assigned to a profile (Devices tab)

manage.backup.password_prompt: Parent password (the backup contains secrets in plain text):
manage.backup.secrets_warning: ⚠️ The backup contains the parent password, the AI key and the Wi-Fi keys, in plain text. Keep it somewhere safe.
ob.country_hint: Determines which Wi-Fi channels are allowed. Please set this correctly.
ob.pairing_hint: Shown at the end of the box installation. It ensures a parent is the one setting Protectado up.
child.privacy_records: Protectado records the NAMES of the sites visited — never their content, never your messages, never your passwords.
child.retention: Kept for {n} days, then deleted automatically.
child.retention_unlimited: ⚠️ Unlimited retention: nothing is deleted automatically.
child.sharing_on: Usage statistics are sent to an AI service for the reports — without your first name, your exact age, or your device address.
child.recently_viewed: A parent looked at your detailed history: {dates}.
event.history_purged: History erased by the parent ({n} records)
manage.privacy.title: Privacy
manage.privacy.retention_warning: ⚠️ With no limit, a child's history builds up indefinitely — including the analyses produced by the AI.
manage.privacy.retention_short: ⚠️ Below {n} days, weekly and monthly reviews will have nothing left to work with.
manage.privacy.share_hint: Reports and chat. What is sent is pseudonymised: “Child 1” and an age range — never a first name, an exact age, or an IP address.
manage.privacy.share_off_note: Disabled: blocking, schedules and alerts keep working normally.
profiles.privacy_hint: Changes neither blocking, schedules nor alerts: only what can be reconstructed afterwards.
profiles.purge_confirm: Permanently erase all of {name}'s history? Their settings and schedules are kept.
